commits.message: Port optional MT6661 locked-device reset protection to 6.12.58

qualification: Default source profile for this device candidate. Kernel, module-cohort CRC/signature, loader-policy and BTF host checks passed. Hardware boot, user functional checks, physical locked-screen power/reset blocking and automatic Virtual A/B merge passed on LDY-AN00 build 20261116.015015 with the matching MagicOS 11.0.0.117 stack. The legacy-release migration bridge and fresh installer were not covered by these hardware tests. LDY_AN00_RESET_GUARD=0 retains the unprotected baseline.
